modelingFreedom: Useful native changes to forms, proportions, construction, decoration and topology are authorized; source part counts and weak details are not requirements.

visibleCriteria.outcome: All four views read as a broad low shelf, with a rounded/chamfered upper shoulder and understandable layered rock mass. Improve major form readability over the planar source without violating the measured finite envelope.

Retain the blue/cyan family: lighter upper planes and deeper lower mass, with broad soft shading and controlled highlights. Avoid a flat neon plate, crushed black underband, metallic glare or target-painted halo.

Interior slabs, clefts, strata or sparse pebbles add construction and depth without repetitive ruler lines, busy caustic noise or disconnected ornament. Details read as rock at logical 128 and do not turn into confetti at phone 32.
N/E/S/W maintain the same palette, form quality and material logic. Do not invent unseen target surfaces; ensure equivalent authored quality and no horizontal preferred light direction.

Both actual ports meet the exact approved middle's native profile, material/albedo and normal field. In independently assembled all-four-direction views, joints do not show local bright/dark stripes, notches, raised lids, cracks, holes or exposed caps. A broad finite-light gradient must be reported separately, never used to waive a visible local seam.
No clipping, float, black cavities, z-fighting, cut-off decorations, alpha fringe, opaque floor, unintended ground shadow or sprite-rectangle halo on light/gray/dark backgrounds.

hardConstraints: Measured actual two opposing straight local-X ports, finite ground profile and envelope; resolve any metadata contradiction before editing.
